criteria.description: Resolver emits a schema-valid Routing Plan for each of the five terminal states with required and forbidden content proven by tests.
Exactly one registered workflow is selected via task_class with a recorded reason; a schema-invalid envelope or unregistered task_class is rejected at the input boundary (exit 2).
Domain resolution reads the pinned commit, matches exact task_type, respects the overlay, fails closed on absent capability or Skill artifact, and invents nothing.
Approval gates derive from workflow policy and envelope hints, carry the documented scope fingerprint, and transitions via a decisions record yield routed or approval_rejected.
Every emitted plan passes validate_routing.py and the fingerprint algorithm is deterministic and scope-sensitive.
Android example resolves as unroutable with no selection; a positive needs_approval-then-routed path exists against engineering.web.
Deterministic mapping and fingerprint rules are documented; focused tests and the complete Harness gate pass.
